en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a small piazza dominated by a stone church with a tall campanile clock tower. The tower has a square base, arched belfry openings, a pyramidal spire with a weather vane, and a large clock face showing Roman numerals. The church façade features a portico with three arches, a circular window (oculus) above, and a tile roof. A gravel square and a few trees frame the foreground, with wooded mountains rising steeply in the background. A single person stands near the church entrance, giving a quiet rural atmosphere.
